title: 군인 급식 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:24105:20120919:00003:part:1/1

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 24105, September 19, 2012>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Amendment to Other Statutes or Regulations)
The Enforcement Decree of the Military Service Act shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 158 (3), "Regulations on Rations for Military Personnel and Civilian Military Employees" shall be replaced with "Regulations on Rations for Military Personnel".
